subject: lavaan error when I using cluster=

messages.author: 01efe658e505ff8b
messages.subject: lavaan error when I using cluster=
parts:
Dear all,
I'm using lavaan to explore the mediation role of patients' socioeconomic status on gender disparity of patients' in-hospital healthy outcomes (like mortality). As my patients came from different hospitals, I want to control the cluster effect of each hospital. So I used variable "hosid" as an indicator of each hospital, and made it a character variable as required. My code is as follow:

Model1 <-'
     sef =~ education  + job +  PERINCOMEYN 
  # mediator
     sef ~ a*gender
     mace2 ~ b*sef
  # direct effect
     mace2 ~ c*gender
  # indirect effect (a*b)
     ab :=a*b
  # total effect
     total := c + (a*b)
     '
fit <- sem(Model1, 
                  data=stemi1, 
                  ordered = c("job","education","PERINCOMEYN"), 
                   cluster = "hosid")
summary(fit,standardized=TRUE)


If I took away cluster part, this code run well. But here comes " Error in th.start.idx[i]:th.end.idx[i]参数 " when I run the code (with cluster="hosid" ). 
There is no missing of variable "hosid". 

I have spent several hours trying to research it myself and unfortunately have not found anything (even uninstall my R and reinstall the newest version). I would be very happy if one of you could help me. Thanks a lot!

messages.subject: Re: lavaan error when I using cluster=
